data.notes: It got the header right and correctly says the win came from a value case built on the customer's own data, with no dollar figure stated and no claims about what Fiserv pitched. It also reports the global/infrastructure opener as silence and covers the proposal-to-the-wrong-buyer, language, distributor reference and rate-versus-problem lessons with accurate quotes. It never states the month-end close (nine days, 'week of archaeology') as the real trigger, and it misses the counter card readers that were shown on a slide but never demoed.
